stem: 设 $ z = f\left(\mathrm{e}^{x} \sin y, x^{2} + y^{2}\right) $，其中 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
answer: $\displaystyle \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\mathrm{e}^{2x}\sin y\cos y\,f_{11}^{\prime\prime}+2\mathrm{e}^{x}(y\sin y+x\cos y)f_{12}^{\prime\prime}+4xyf_{22}^{\prime\prime}+\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y\,f_{1}^{\prime}$，其中各偏导均在 $\left(\mathrm{e}^{x}\sin y,x^{2}+y^{2}\right)$ 处取值。
explanation:
首先，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \mathrm{e}^{x}\sin y \cdot f_{1}^{\prime} + 2x \cdot f_{2}^{\prime} $。
然后，$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) = f_{1}^{\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y + \mathrm{e}^{x}\sin y \left( f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y + 2f_{12}^{\prime\prime}y \right) + 2x \left( f_{21}^{\prime\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y + 2f_{22}^{\prime\prime}y \right) $。
由于 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$ f_{12}^{\prime\prime} = f_{21}^{\prime\prime} $，整理得：$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\mathrm{e}^{2x}\sin y\cos y + 2\mathrm{e}^{x}f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(y\sin y + x\cos y) + 4xyf_{22}^{\prime\prime} + f_{1}^{\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y $。

stem: 设 $ z = \sin(xy) + \varphi\left(x, \frac{x}{y}\right) $，其中 $ \varphi(u, v) $ 有二阶偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y} $。
answer: $\displaystyle \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\cos(xy)-xy\sin(xy)-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\varphi_{uv}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{1}{y^{2}}\varphi_{v}^{\prime}-\frac{x}{y^{3}}\varphi_{vv}^{\prime\prime}$，其中 $\varphi$ 的各偏导均在 $\left(x,\frac{x}{y}\right)$ 处取值。
explanation:
首先，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = y\cos(xy) + \varphi_{u}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y}\varphi_{v}^{\prime} $。
然后，$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) = \cos(xy) - xy\sin(xy) + \left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right)\varphi_{uv}^{\prime\prime} + \left(-\frac{1}{y^{2}}\right)\varphi_{v}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y}\left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right)\varphi_{vv}^{\prime\prime} $。
整理得：$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \cos(xy) - xy\sin(xy) - \frac{x}{y^{2}}\varphi_{uv}^{\prime\prime} - \frac{1}{y^{2}}\varphi_{v}^{\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{3}}\varphi_{vv}^{\prime\prime} $。

stem: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有 2 阶连续偏导数，且 $ \left. \mathrm{d}f \right|_{(1,1)} = 3 \mathrm{d}u + 4 \mathrm{d}v $. 令 $ y = f(\cos x, 1+x^{2}) $，则 $ \left.\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=0}= $ ___.
explanation:
由 $ \left.\mathrm{d}f\right|_{(1,1)}=3\mathrm{d}u+4\mathrm{d}v $，知 $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\right|_{(1,1)}=3,\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right|_{(1,1)}=4 $。

因为 $ y = f(\cos x, 1 + x^{2}) $，所以

$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot(-\sin x)+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot(2x) 
$$

$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}=&-\cos x\cdot\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}-\sin x\cdot\left[\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}\cdot(-\sin x)+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v\partial u}\cdot(2x)\right]\\&+2\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}+2x\left[\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}\cdot(-\sin x)+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\cdot(2x)\right].\end{aligned} 
$$

将 $ x=0 $ 代入，得 $ \left.\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=0}=-\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\right|_{(1,1)}+2\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right|_{(1,1)}=-3+8=5 $。

explanation:
（Ⅰ）先将函数关系改写为新变量的形式

由 $u=x+y$、$v=x-y$，解得

$$
x=\frac{u+v}{2}, y=\frac{u-v}{2}.
$$

因此

$$
xy=\frac{u^2-v^2}{4}.
$$

记

$$
Z(u,v)=z\left(\frac{u+v}{2},\frac{u-v}{2}\right),
$$

则

$$
w(u,v)=\frac{u^2-v^2}{4}-Z(u,v).
$$

固定 $v$ 对 $u$ 求导。因为 $x_u=y_u=1/2$，且 $x_{uu}=y_{uu}=0$，链式法则直接给出

$$
Z_{uu}=\frac14z_{xx}+\frac12z_{xy}+\frac14z_{yy}=0.
$$

所以

$$
w_{uu}=\frac12-Z_{uu}=\frac12.
$$

无需先把 $z_x,z_y,z_{xx},z_{xy},z_{yy}$ 全部用 $w$ 的导数展开。

（Ⅱ）对 $u$ 两次积分，并利用给定条件

由第一问，

$$
w_u=\frac u2+C_1(v).
$$

代入 $w_u(0,v)=ve^{-v}$，得 $C_1(v)=ve^{-v}$，于是

$$
w=\frac{u^2}{4}+uve^{-v}+C_2(v).
$$

再由 $w(0,v)=v^2/4$，得 $C_2(v)=v^2/4$。因此

$$
w=\frac{u^2+v^2}{4}+uve^{-v}.
$$

由 $z=xy-w$，代回 $u=x+y$、$v=x-y$，得到

$$
z(x,y)=xy-\frac{x^2+y^2}{2}
-(x^2-y^2)e^{-(x-y)}.
$$

检验时，在新变量下有 $Z=-v^2/2-uve^{-v}$，所以 $Z_{uu}=0$，满足原偏微分方程；两条给定条件也可直接代回验证。

stem: 设 $ f(x, y) $ 有二阶连续偏导数, 满足 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x, y) = f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(x, y) $, $ f(x, 2x) = x^2 $, $ f_x^{\prime}(x, 2x) = x $, 则 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) = $ ___ $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) = $ ___.
explanation:
$ f(x,2x)=x^{2} $两端对x求导，得 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,2x)+2f_{y}^{\prime}(x,2x)=2x $，故 $ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{x}{2} $。
$ f_{x}^{\prime}(x,2x)=x $ 两端对 x 求导，得 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)+2f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=1 $。
$ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{x}{2} $ 两端对 x 求导，得 $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)+2f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{1}{2} $。
由 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(x,y) $， $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=f_{yx}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x) $，得 $ f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=0 $， $ f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{1}{2} $。

stem: 设有二阶连续偏导数的函数 $ u = u(s, t) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial s^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial t^{2}} $ 以及 $ u(x, 2x) = x^{2} $, $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x, 2x) = 4x $. 求 $ u_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) $ 和 $ u_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, 2x) $.
explanation:
由 $ u(x,2x)=x^{2} $ 可得， $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x,2x)+2u_{2}^{\prime}(x,2x)=2x. $ 代入 $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x,2x)=4x $ ，解得 $ u_{2}^{\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{2x-4x}{2}=-x. $
对 $ u_{1}^{\prime}(x,2x)=4x,u_{2}^{\prime}(x,2x)=-x $ 两端同时关于 x 求导得
$$
 \begin{cases}u_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)+2u_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)=4,\\u_{21}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)+2u_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)=-1.\end{cases} 
$$
 
由于 u 的二阶偏导数连续，故 $ u_{21}^{\prime\prime} = u_{12}^{\prime\prime} $。又由已知条件知 $ u_{22}^{\prime\prime} = -u_{11}^{\prime\prime} $，代入上式得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}u_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)+2u_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)&=4,\\ u_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)-2u_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x,2x)&=-1.\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
解得 $ u_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{6}{5},u_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x,2x)=\frac{7}{5}. $

stem: 设函数 $ z = f(x \cos y, y g(x)) $，其中函数 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且 $ f_{12}''(1,0) = 1 $，函数 $ g(x) $ 可导，且在 $ x = 1 $ 处取得极值 $ g(1) = 2 $。求 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{x=1\atop y=0} $。
explanation:
由链式法则，
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}&=f_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\frac{\partial\left(x\cos y\right)}{\partial x}+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\frac{\partial\left[yg(x)\right]}{\partial x}\\&=\cos yf_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)+yg^{\prime}(x)f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right),\\\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial\left[\cos yf_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)+yg^{\prime}(x)f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\right]}{\partial y}\\&=-\sin yf_{1}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)+\cos y\left[f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\cdot\left(-x\sin y\right)\right.\\&\left.\quad+f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)g(x)\right]+g^{\prime}(x)f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\\&\quad+yg^{\prime}(x)\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)\cdot\left(-x\sin y\right)+f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x\cos y,yg(x)\right)g(x)\right]\end{aligned} 
$$
 
由 $ g(x) $ 可导且在 $ x = 1 $ 处取得极值 $ g(1) = 2 $ 知， $ g'(1) = 0 $。将 $ x = 1, y = 0, g(1) = 2, g'(1) = 0 $ 代入 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} $，得
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{\substack{x=1\\ y=0}}=2f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(1,0\right)=2. 
$$

 =e^{xy}+xye^{xy}+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+(x+y)\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}+xy\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}

stem: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足 $ 4\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}=1 $，又 $ g(x,y)=f(x^{2}+y^{2},xy) $，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}= $ ___.
explanation:
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot2x+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot y 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}&=2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+2x\left(\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}\cdot2x+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}\cdot y\right)+y\left(\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v\partial u}\cdot2x+\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\cdot y\right)\\&=2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+4x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+4xy\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}+4y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}+4xy\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v}+x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=4(x^{2}-y^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}-(x^{2}-y^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}=(x^{2}-y^{2})\left(4\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}}\right)=x^{2}-y^{2}. 
$$

stem: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，函数 $ g(x,y)=x^{2}+y^{2}-f(x+y,xy) $。求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $。
explanation:
由于函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，故 $ f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(u,v)=f_{21}^{\prime\prime}(u,v) $。分别计算 $ \frac{\partial g}{\partial x},\frac{\partial g}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}},\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}},\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=2x-f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)-yf_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy), 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=2y-f_{1}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-xf_{2}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right), 
$$
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-yf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-y\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+yf_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)\right]\\&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-2yf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-y^{2}f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right),\end{align*} 
$$
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}&=-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-y\big[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)+xf_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)\big]-f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy)\\&=-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-(x+y)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-xyf_{22}^{\prime \prime}(x+y,xy)-f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,xy),\end{align*} 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-x\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+xf_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)\right]\\&=2-f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-2xf_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)-x^{2}f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(x+y,xy\right).\end{aligned} 
$$
代入 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $ 可得，
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=4-\left(x-y\right)^{2}f_{22}^{\prime\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right)+2f_{2}^{\prime}\left(x+y,xy\right). 
$$
source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 34

stem: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，函数 $ g(x,y)=xy-f\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right) $，求 $ x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+2xy\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $
explanation:
由题，函数复合关系如图所示，所以 
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=y-f_{u}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right)-f_{v}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\frac{1}{y}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=x-f_{u}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\frac{1}{x}-f_{v}^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\right)\left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right), 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big[f_{u u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big)+f_{u v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{y}\Big]+f_{u}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{2y}{x^{3}}\Big)-\\&\quad\frac{1}{y}\Big[f_{v u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big)+f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{y}\Big]\\&=-\frac{y^{2}}{x^{4}}f_{u u}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{2}{x^{2}}f_{u v}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{1}{y^{2}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{2y}{x^{3}}f_{u}^{\prime},\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}&=1+f_{u}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x^{2}}+\frac{y}{x^{2}}\Big[f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}+f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\Big)\Big]+\\&\quad\frac{1}{y^{2}}f_{v}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)-\frac{1}{y}\Big[f_{v u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}-\frac{x}{y^{2}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big]\\&=1+\frac{y}{x^{3}}f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{2}{xy}f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{x}{y^{3}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{1}{x^{2}}f_{u}^{\prime}+\frac{1}{y^{2}}f_{v}^{\prime},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}&=-\frac{1}{x}\Big[f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}+f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\Big)\Big]-\frac{2x}{y^{3}}f_{v}^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)+\\&\quad\frac{x}{y^{2}}\Big[f_{v u}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\frac{1}{x}-\frac{x}{y^{2}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x},\frac{x}{y}\Big)\Big]\\&=-\frac{1}{x^{2}}f_{uu}^{\prime\prime}+\frac{2}{y^{2}}f_{uv}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{x^{2}}{y^{4}}f_{v v}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{2x}{y^{3}}f_{v}^{\prime},\end{aligned} 
$$
 故 
$$
 x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+2xy\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=2xy. 
$$

stem: 设 $ f(u) = \ln u, u = \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}} $，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial y^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial z^{2}} $.
explanation:
由题可得， 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x}&=\frac{1}{u}\cdot\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}}\cdot\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}}\\&=\frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}},\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\Big(\frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}\Big)=\frac{y^{2}+z^{2}-x^{2}}{(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})^{2}}. 
$$
 由变量对称性，有 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{z^{2}+x^{2}-y^{2}}{(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial z^{2}}=\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}-z^{2}}{(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})^{2}}, 
$$
 故得 $ \frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial y^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}\left[f(u)\right]}{\partial z^{2}}=\frac{1}{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}. $

stem: 若二元函数 $ f(x,y) $ 存在二阶连续偏导数，且满足 $ f(x,y) = -f(y,x) $，则下列结论中，错误的是()
explanation: 记 $ u = f(x, y) $, $ v = f(y, x) $, 则 $ u = -v $, $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}} $, $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x \partial y} = -\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x \partial y} $. 分别计算 u, v 的一阶、二阶偏导数: $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}\left(x,y\right),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\left(x,y\right),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}=f_{12}^{\prime\prime}\left(x,y\right) $, $ \frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=f_{2}^{\prime}(y,x),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}=f_{22}^{\prime \prime}(y,x),\quad\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x\partial y}=f_{21}^{\prime \prime}(y,x) $. 于是， $ f_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=-f_{22}^{\prime\prime}(y,x) $， $ f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=-f_{21}^{\prime\prime}(y,x) $。选项B和选项D正确。由于 $ f(x,y) $存在二阶连续偏导数，故 $ f_{12}''(x,y)=f_{21}''(x,y) $。选项C正确。由排除法可知，应选 A. 下面举例说明选项 A 错误: 例如， $ f(x,y)=x^{3}-y^{3} $ 满足题干要求，但 $ f_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=6x,f_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=-6y,f_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)\neq f_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x,y) $.

explanation: 根据链式法则，$\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right|_{x=0} = f_{1}^{\prime}(f(0,1),1) \cdot \left[ f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1) + f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1) \right] + f_{2}^{\prime}(f(0,1),1) = 3f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1) + f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1) = 5$.

stem: 设函数 $ f(x, y) $ 可微，且 $ f(0, 0) = 0 $， $ f_{1}^{\prime}(0, 0) = a $， $ f_{2}^{\prime}(0, 0) = b $。令 $ \varphi(t) = f(\sin t, f(\tan t, 1 - \cos t)) $，则 $ \varphi^{\prime}(0) = $ ___.
explanation: 根据链式法则，$\varphi^{\prime}(t)=f_{1}^{\prime}(\sin t,f(\tan t,1-\cos t))\cos t + f_{2}^{\prime}(\sin t,f(\tan t,1-\cos t))\left[f_{1}^{\prime}(\tan t,1-\cos t)\sec^{2}t+f_{2}^{\prime}(\tan t,1-\cos t)\sin t\right]$。因此，$ \varphi^{\prime}(0)=f_{1}^{\prime}(0,f(0,0))+f_{2}^{\prime}(0,f(0,0))f_{1}^{\prime}(0,0)=a(1+b)$.

stem: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数， $ f(0,1) = 1 $ 是 $ f(u,v) $ 的极值， $ z = f(2x + y, f(x,y)) $。求 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{(0,1)} $。
explanation: 对 $ z = f(2x + y, f(x, y)) $ 两端关于 $x$ 求偏导数得 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=2f_{1}^{\prime}(2x+y,f(x,y))+f_{2}^{\prime}(2x+y,f(x,y))\cdot f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)$。继续对上式两端关于 $y$ 求偏导数得 $\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=2f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)+2f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)+\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)+f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\right]f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)$。由极值的必要条件可知 $ f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1)=0 $。将 $ f(0,1)=1,f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1)=0 $ 代入上式可得 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)}=2f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(1,1\right)+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(1,1\right)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(0,1\right)$.

stem: 已知函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数， $ f(1, 1) = 1 $ 是 $ f(x, y) $ 的极值，且 $ z = f[xy, f(x, y)] $，则 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{(1,1)} = (\quad) $.
explanation: 由题，复合函数 $ z = f[xy, f(x, y)] $ 的复合结构图（略）。$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}\left[x y,f(x,y)\right]\cdot y+f_{2}^{\prime}\left[x y,f(x,y)\right]\cdot f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)$。$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\{f_{11}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot x+f_{12}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\}y+f_{1}^{\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]+\{f_{21}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]x+f_{22}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\}f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)+f_{2}^{\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)$。由于 $ f(1,1)=1 $ 是极值，故 $ f_{1}^{\prime}(1,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(1,1)=0 $，于是 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}=f^{\prime \prime}_{11}(1,1)=f^{\prime \prime}_{uu}(1,1)$.

stem: 设函数 $ f(x, y) $ 可微，满足 $ \left( \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} \right)^2 + \left( \frac{\partial f}{\partial y} \right)^2 = 1 $， $ z(r, \theta) $ 为 $ f(x, y) $ 在极坐标系下的表示，则对单位圆周上的任一点 $ (1, \theta) $， $ \left( \frac{\partial z}{\partial r} \right)^2 + \left( \frac{\partial z}{\partial \theta} \right)^2 = $ ___.
explanation:
在极坐标系下，$ x=r\cos\theta, y=r\sin\theta $。
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial r}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\cos\theta+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\sin\theta, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial\theta}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial\theta}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial\theta}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}(-r\sin\theta)+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}r\cos\theta. 
$$
当 $ r=1 $ 时，
$$
 \begin{aligned}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial r}\right)^{2}&+\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial\theta}\right)^{2}=\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\cos\theta+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\sin\theta\right)^{2}+\left[\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}(-\sin\theta)+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\cos\theta\right]^{2}\\&=\left(\cos^{2}\theta+\sin^{2}\theta\right)\left[\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right)^{2}\right]\\&=\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right)^{2}=1.\end{aligned} 
$$
source: 900 第四章数二 B 类 20

stem: 设可微函数 $ z = f(x, y) $ 在极坐标变换下满足 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial r} = r $，则 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(1,0) + f_{y}^{\prime}(0,1) = $ ___.
explanation:
由极坐标变换 $ \left\{\begin{aligned} x &= r\cos\theta, \\ y &= r\sin\theta \end{aligned}\right. $ 和链式法则，可知
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial r}=f_{x}^{\prime}\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}+f_{y}^{\prime}\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}=\cos\theta f_{x}^{\prime}+\sin\theta f_{y}^{\prime}=r. 
$$
上式两端同乘 $ r $，可得 $ xf_{x}^{\prime} + yf_{y}^{\prime} = r^{2} $。
分别代入 $ (x,y)=(1,0) $， $ (x,y)=(0,1) $，可得 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(1,0)=1 $， $ f_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)=1 $。因此， $ f_{x}^{\prime}(1,0)+f_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)=2 $。

stem: 设变换 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x-2y,\\ v&=x+ay\end{aligned}\right. $ 可把方程 $ 6\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ 简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $ ，求常数 $ a $ 。（这里应假设 $ z $ 有二阶连续偏导数）
explanation:
由变换 $ u = x - 2y $, $ v = x + ay $，计算一阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial u} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, \quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -2\frac{\partial z}{\partial u} + a\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}. 
$$
计算二阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} + 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = -2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} + (a-2)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} = 4\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} - 4a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}. 
$$
代入原方程 $ 6\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $，整理得：
$$
 (10+5a)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + (6+a-a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}} = 0. 
$$
为使方程简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} = 0 $，需满足：
$$
 \begin{cases}10+5a \neq 0, \\ 6+a-a^{2} = 0.\end{cases} 
$$
由 $ 6+a-a^{2} = 0 $ 得 $ (3-a)(2+a) = 0 $，解得 $ a = 3 $ 或 $ a = -2 $。由 $ 10+5a \neq 0 $ 得 $ a \neq -2 $，且若 $ a = -2 $ 则 $ u = v $，变换无意义。因此取 $ a = 3 $。

stem: 设函数 $ z(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，则下列各项中的变换能将方程 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ 化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $ 的是（）
explanation:
观察选项知，可设 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x+by,\\ v&=cx+y.\end{aligned}\right. $ 将 u, v 看作中间变量，分别计算 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}, \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}, \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} $。计算得： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}+c\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=b\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+2c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+c^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+c\frac{\partial z^{2}}{\partial v^{2}}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=b\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+\left(1+b c\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\;=\;b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\;\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\;+\;b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\;\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\;\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}\;\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\;=\;b^{2}\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\;+\;2b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}. 
$$
 代入原方程 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $，可得 
$$
 \left(2+b-3b^{2}\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+\left(4c+1+b c-6b\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+\left(2c^{2}+c-3\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}=0. 
$$
 由已知条件，该方程可化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $，故 
$$
 \begin{cases}2+b-3b^{2}=0,\\4c+1+bc-6b\neq0,\\2c^{2}+c-3=0.\end{cases} 
$$
 解得 b = 1 或 $ -\frac{2}{3} $，c = 1 或 $ -\frac{3}{2} $。由此可排除选项 A、C、D。并且，选项 B 满足 $ b = -\frac{2}{3} $，c = 1，且符合 $ 4c + 1 + bc - 6b \neq 0 $ 的要求。因此，应选 B.
source: 900 第四章数二 B 类

stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 二阶偏导数连续，且 $ \begin{cases} u = x + ay, \\ v = x + by \end{cases} $（$a \lt b$）可将方程 $ 3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} - 4\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $ 化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u \partial v} = 0, z(x, 0) = \sin x, z_{y}^{\prime}(x, 0) = 0. $ (1) 求 $a,b$ 的值；(2) 求 $ z(x,y) $ 的表达式.
explanation:
由 $u=x+ay$，$v=x+by$ 得 $z_x=z_u+z_v$，$z_y=az_u+bz_v$。代入原方程后，$z_{uu}$ 与 $z_{vv}$ 的系数分别为 $a^2-4a+3$、$b^2-4b+3$。令二者为 $0$，并由 $a\lt b$ 得 $a=1,b=3$，此时方程化为 $z_{uv}=0$。故 $z=f(x+y)+g(x+3y)$。由 $z(x,0)=\sin x$ 得 $f(x)+g(x)=\sin x$；由 $z_y(x,0)=0$ 得 $f'(x)+3g'(x)=0$。再由 $f'(x)+g'(x)=\cos x$，解得 $f'(x)=\frac{3}{2}\cos x$，$g'(x)=-\frac{1}{2}\cos x$。积分并结合 $f(x)+g(x)=\sin x$，得 
$$
z=\frac{3}{2}\sin(x+y)-\frac{1}{2}\sin(x+3y).
$$

stem: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，作变量代换 $ \xi = x, \eta = y - x $，将方程 $ \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + 2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x \partial y} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = 0 $ 化为以 $ \xi, \eta $ 为自变量的方程。
explanation:
由题，函数复合关系如图所示，所以 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta},\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{\partial}{\partial\xi}\big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\big)\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial}{\partial\eta}\big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\big)\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial}{\partial\xi}\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\Big)\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial}{\partial\eta}\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\Big)\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}. 
$$
 故 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}=0, 
$$
 即 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}=0. 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 利用变量代换化简偏微分方程 / 线性变换

stem: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足等式 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + 3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} + \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $。确定 a, b 的值，使等式在变换 $ \xi = x + ay, \eta = bx + 2y (ab \neq 2) $ 下简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0 $。
explanation:
由 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}\xi&=x+ay,\\ \eta&=bx+2y\end{aligned}\right. $ 可得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x&=\frac{a\eta-2\xi}{ab-2},\\ y&=\frac{b\xi-\eta}{ab-2}.\end{aligned}\right. $ 注意到 $ u=f(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数。由链式法则， $ u=f(x(\xi,\eta),y(\xi,\eta)) $ 仍具有关于 $ \xi,\eta $ 的二阶连续偏导数，从而 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi} $。由链式法则可得， 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(ab+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+4a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 代入 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ ，整理得 
$$
 \left(a^{2}+3a+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(2b^{2}+6b+4\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}+\left[3\left(a b+2\right)+4a+4b\right]\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0. 
$$
 由上式等价于 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0 $可得， 
$$
 \begin{cases}a^{2}+3a+2=0,\\2b^{2}+6b+4=0,\\3\left(ab+2\right)+4a+4b\neq0.\end{cases} 
$$
 由前两个方程解得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-1,\\ b&=-1,\end{aligned}\right. $或 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-2,\\ b&=-2\end{aligned}\right. $（舍去ab=2的解）。 将这两组解代入 $ 3(ab+2)+4a+4b $均不为零，故这两组解均符合要求。
source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 38

stem: 设 $u(x,y)$ 有二阶连续偏导数，利用变换 $\xi=x+ay,\eta=x+by$，将方程 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0$ 化为 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0$，求 $a,b$ 的值。
explanation: 视 $\xi$、$\eta$ 为中间变量，$x$、$y$ 为自变量。由已知，得 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\cdot1+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\cdot1$，$\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\cdot a+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\cdot b$。这里 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}$、$\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}$ 是以 $\xi$、$\eta$ 为中间变量，$x$、$y$ 为自变量的二元函数，故 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$，$\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2ab\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$，$\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+(a+b)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$。代入已知方程，得 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=(1+4a+3a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left[2+4(a+b)+6ab\right]\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+(1+4b+3b^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$。又由已知，得 $\begin{cases}1+4a+3a^{2}=0,\\1+4b+3b^{2}=0,\\2+4(a+b)+6ab\neq0,\end{cases}$ 联立①、②式解得 $\left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-1,\\ b&=-\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}\right.$ 或 $\left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-\frac{1}{3},\\ b&=-1,\end{aligned}\right.$ 且都满足③式，故为所求。
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 利用变量代换化简偏微分方程 / 线性变换

stem: 已知函数 $ u(x,y) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-4\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=0 $，求 $ a,b $ 的值，使得在变换 $ u(x,y)=v(x,y)e^{ax+by} $ 下，上述等式可化为不含 $ v(x,y) $ 的一阶偏导数的等式。
explanation:
由 $ u(x,y)=v(x,y)\mathrm{e}^{ax+by} $ 可得，
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\cdot av=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\cdot b v=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b v\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=a\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right)+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}+a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(2a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+a^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=b\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+bv\right)+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}+b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(2b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}\right). 
$$
代入已知等式可得，
$$
 \mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left[\left(2a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+a^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}\right)-2\left(2b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}\right)+3\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right)-4\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+bv\right)\right]=0. 
$$
整理上式，可得
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}+(2a+3)\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}-(4b+4)\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+(a^{2}v-2b^{2}v+3a v-4b v)=0. 
$$
要使得式中不含有 $ v(x,y) $ 的一阶偏导数，需使 $ 2a+3=0,4b+4=0 $。解得 $ a=-\frac{3}{2},b=-1 $。
因此，$ a=-\frac{3}{2},b=-1 $。
source: 900 第四章数二 A 类37

stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ \ln z + e^{z-1} = xy $ 确定，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2, \frac{1}{2})} = $ ___
explanation:
（法一）对已知方程两端关于 $x$ 求导，可得 $ \frac{1}{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+e^{z-1}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y $。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2} $ 代入已知方程可得， $ \ln z + e^{z-1} = 1 $，解得 $z = 1$。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2}, z = 1 $ 代入上式可得， $ 2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})} = \frac{1}{2} $，即 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})} = \frac{1}{4} $。
（法二）记 $ F(x,y,z) = \ln z + e^{z-1} - xy $，则 $ F_{x}^{\prime}(x,y,z) = -y $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z) = \frac{1}{z} + e^{z-1} $。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2} $ 代入已知方程可得 $z=1$。根据隐函数存在定理， $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}\left(2,\frac{1}{2},1\right)}{F_{z}^{\prime}\left(2,\frac{1}{2},1\right)}=-\frac{-\frac{1}{2}}{2}=\frac{1}{4} $。

stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = y \cos x + 2x $ 确定，则 $ \left. \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \right|_{(0,1)} = $ ___.
explanation:
解法 1：对已知方程两端关于 $ x $ 求偏导数，可得 
$$
 \frac{1}{z+1}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\mathrm{e}^{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-y\sin x+2. 
$$
 将 $ x = 0, y = 1 $ 代入已知方程可得 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $。令 $ f(z) = \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} - 1 $，则 $ f'(z) = \frac{1}{z + 1} + e^{z} $。当 $ z > -1 $ 时， $ f'(z) > 0 $， $ f(z) $ 单调增加。观察可得 $ f(0) = 0 $，结合 $ f(z) $ 的单调性可知 $ z = 0 $ 为 $ f(z) $ 的唯一零点，即 $ z = 0 $ 为方程 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $ 的唯一实根。将 $ x = 0, y = 1, z = 0 $ 代入上式可得 $ 2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)} = 2 $，即 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)} = 1 $。
解法 2：记 $ F(x, y, z) = \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} - y \cos x - 2x $，则 
$$
 F_{x}^{\prime}(x,y,z)=y\sin x-2,\quad F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z)=\frac{1}{z+1}+e^{z}. 
$$
 将 $ x = 0, y = 1 $ 代入已知方程可得 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $。同解法 1 得 $ z = 0 $。根据隐函数存在定理， 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}(0,1,0)}{F_{z}^{\prime}(0,1,0)}=-\frac{-2}{2}=1. 
$$
source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 22
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元隐函数求偏导 / 一个方程三个未知数（常规） / 一阶 / 具体

stem: 设隐函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ y + z = x f(y^{2} - z^{2}) $ 确定，$ f $ 可微，则 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + z \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $ 等于
explanation:
令 $ F(x,y,z)=y+z-xf(y^{2}-z^{2}) $，于是 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{-f}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=\frac{f}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{1-2xyf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}, 
$$
 所以 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+z\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{xf-z+2xyzf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=\frac{xf-xf+y+2xyzf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=y $。故应选(C)。

stem: 设 $ f(x) $ 为连续函数，且 $ x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = \int_{x}^{y} f(x + y - t) \, dt $ 确定二元函数 $ z = z(x, y) $，则 $ z\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right) = $ ___.
explanation: 令 $ x+y-t=u $，则 $ \int_{x}^{y}f(x+y-t)dt=-\int_{y}^{x}f(u)du $。记 $ F(x,y,z)=x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}+\int_{y}^{x}f(u)du $。由隐函数求导法则， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{2x+f(x)}{2z} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{2y-f(y)}{2z} $。因此，原式 $ = z \left( -\frac{2x+f(x)}{2z} - \frac{2y-f(y)}{2z} \right) = -x - y - \frac{1}{2} [f(x) - f(y)] $。
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元隐函数求偏导 / 一个方程三个未知数（常规） / 一阶 / 具体

stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ (x + 1)z + 2y \ln z - \arctan(xy) = 1 $ 确定，则 $ \left. \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \right|_{(0,2)} = $ ___.
explanation:
将 $ x=0, y=2 $ 代入 $ (x+1)z+2y\ln z-\arctan(xy)=1 $，有 $ z+4\ln z=1 $。因为 $ z + 4 \ln z $ 是 $ (0, +\infty) $ 上的增函数，且当 $ z = 1 $ 时， $ z + 4 \ln z = 1 $，从而解得 $ z = 1 $。在 $ (x+1)z+2y\ln z-\arctan(xy)=1 $ 两端对 $ x $ 求偏导，有 
$$
 z+(x+1)\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+2y\cdot\frac{1}{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-\frac{1}{1+(xy)^{2}}\cdot y=0, 
$$
 将 $ x=0, y=2, z=1 $ 代入上式，解得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)}=\frac{1}{5} $。

stem: 设函数 $ f(x,y,z)=\mathrm{e}^{z}yz^{2} $，若 $ z=z(x,y) $ 是由方程 $ x+y+z+xyz=0 $ 所确定的隐函数，记 $ g(x,y)=f(x,y,z(x,y)) $，则 $ g'_y(0,1)= $ ___.
explanation:
解法 1：将 $ x = 0, y = 1 $ 代入 $ x + y + z + xyz = 0 $ 可得 $ z(0,1) + 1 = 0 $，即 $ z(0,1) = -1 $。根据链式法则， $ g_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=\frac{\partial f(x,y,z(x,y))}{\partial y}=\mathrm{e}^{z}y z^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+\mathrm{e}^{z}z^{2}+2\mathrm{e}^{z}y z\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\mathrm{e}^{z}y z(z+2)\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+\mathrm{e}^{z}z^{2} $。对方程 $ x + y + z + xyz = 0 $ 两端关于 $ y $ 求偏导数，可得 $ 1 + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} + xz + xy \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = 0 $，解得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{1 + xz}{1 + xy} $。代入上式可得 $ g_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=-\mathrm{e}^{z}y z(z+2)\frac{1+x z}{1+x y}+\mathrm{e}^{z}z^{2} $。因此， $ g_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)=\mathrm{e}^{-1}+\mathrm{e}^{-1}=\frac{2}{\mathrm{e}} $。
解法 2：利用偏导数的定义。在方程 $ x + y + z + xyz = 0 $ 中代入 $ x = 0 $，可得 $ z(0, y) = -y $。 
$$
 \begin{aligned}g_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)&=\lim_{y\to1}\frac{f(0,y,z(0,y))-f(0,1,-1)}{y-1}=\lim_{y\to1}\frac{y^{3}\mathrm{e}^{-y}-\mathrm{e}^{-1}}{y-1}\\&\xlongequal{ 洛必达 }\lim_{y\to1}(3y^{2}\mathrm{e}^{-y}-y^{3}\mathrm{e}^{-y})=\frac{2}{\mathrm{e}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 23

stem: 设函数 $ z = f(u) $，方程 $ u = \varphi(u) + \int_{y}^{x} p(t) dt $ 确定 $ u $ 是 $ x, y $ 的函数，其中 $ f(u) $, $ \varphi(u) $ 可微； $ p(t) $, $ \varphi'(u) $ 连续，且 $ \varphi'(u) \neq 1 $。求 $ p(y) \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + p(x) \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $。
explanation: 由 $ z = f(u) $ 可知 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}, \quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} $。对方程 $ u = \varphi(u) + \int_{y}^{x} p(t) dt $ 两边分别对 $ x $ 和 $ y $ 求偏导，得 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \varphi'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + p(x) $， $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = \varphi'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} - p(y) $。整理得 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{p(x)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} $， $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = -\frac{p(y)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} $。代入 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $ 和 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $ 的表达式，得 $ p(y) \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + p(x) \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = p(y) f'(u) \cdot \frac{p(x)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} + p(x) f'(u) \cdot \left( -\frac{p(y)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} \right) = 0 $。

stem: 设 $ y = f(x, t) $，$ t = t(x, y) $ 由方程 $ G(x, y, t) = 0 $ 确定，$ f, G $ 可微，则 $ \frac{dy}{dx} = $ ___
explanation: 令 $ F(x, y, t) = f(x, t) - y = 0 $，则 $ \left\{\begin{aligned} F(x, y, t) &= 0, \\ G(x, y, t) &= 0 \end{aligned}\right. $ 确定 $ y = y(x), t = t(x) $。方程组两边同时对 $ x $ 求导，得 $ \begin{cases}F_{x}^{\prime}+F_{y}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+F_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_{x}^{\prime}+f_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x}-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=0,\\G_{x}^{\prime}+G_{y}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+G_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x}=0,\end{cases} $。解方程组，得 $ \frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{G_{t}^{\prime}f_{x}^{\prime}-G_{x}^{\prime}f_{t}^{\prime}}{G_{y}^{\prime}f_{t}^{\prime}+G_{t}^{\prime}} $。

stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 是由方程 $ F\left(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{y} - \frac{1}{z}\right) = \frac{1}{z} $ 确定的隐函数，其中 $ F $ 可微，求 $ x^{2} \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y^{2} \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $。
explanation: 方法一：方程 $ F\left(\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{y}-\frac{1}{z}\right)=\frac{1}{z} $，两边分别对 $ x,y $ 求导，得 $ \begin{cases}F^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{1}{x^{2}}+\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)=-\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x},\\F^{\prime}\bullet\left(\frac{1}{y^{2}}+\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)=-\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y},\end{cases} $。解得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{(F^{\prime}+1)x^{2}},\quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{(F^{\prime}+1)y^{2}} $，故 $ x^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=0 $。方法二：用公式求。令 $ G=F\left(\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{y}-\frac{1}{z}\right)-\frac{1}{z} $，则 $ G_{x}^{\prime}=F^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{1}{x^{2}}\right),\quad G_{y}^{\prime}=F^{\prime}\bullet\frac{1}{y^{2}},\quad G_{z}^{\prime}=F^{\prime}\bullet\frac{1}{z^{2}}+\frac{1}{z^{2}} $，故 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{G_{x}^{\prime}}{G_{z}^{\prime}}=\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{x^{2}(F^{\prime}+1)},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{G_{y}^{\prime}}{G_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{y^{2}(F^{\prime}+1)} $，从而 $ x^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=0 $。

stem:
设 $y=g(x,z)$，而 $z=z(x,y)$ 由方程
$$
f(x-z,xy)=0
$$
确定，求 $\dfrac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}$。
explanation:
把 $y$ 和 $z$ 都看成 $x$ 的函数，直接对题目给出的两个方程关于 $x$ 求导。

由
$$
y=g(x,z)
$$
得
$$
y'=g_1'+g_2'z'.
$$
整理为
$$
y'-g_2'z'=g_1'. \tag{1}
$$

再对
$$
f(x-z,xy)=0
$$
求导。注意此时是全导数，因此
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}(x-z)=1-z',
$$
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}(xy)=y+xy'.
$$
所以
$$
f_1'(1-z')+f_2'(y+xy')=0.
$$
整理为
$$
xf_2'y'-f_1'z'=-f_1'-yf_2'. \tag{2}
$$

用 $f_1'$ 乘式（1），用 $g_2'$ 乘式（2），然后相减，消去 $z'$：
$$
(f_1'-xf_2'g_2')y'
=
f_1'g_1'+g_2'(f_1'+yf_2').
$$
因此
$$
\boxed{
\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}
=
\frac{
f_1'g_1'+g_2'(f_1'+yf_2')
}{
f_1'-xf_2'g_2'
}
}.
$$

这里 $f_1',f_2'$ 分别表示 $f$ 对第一、第二个自变量的偏导，并在 $(x-z,xy)$ 处取值；$g_1',g_2'$ 在 $(x,z)$ 处取值。

stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ F\left(x + \frac{z}{y}, y + \frac{z}{x}\right) = 0 $ 确定，且 $ F(u, v) $ 具有连续偏导数，求 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $.
explanation: 将方程 $ F\left(x+\frac{z}{y},y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0 $ 两边对 $ x $ 求导得 $ F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\Big(1+\frac{1}{y}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\Big)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet\Big(-\frac{z}{x^{2}}+\frac{1}{x}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\Big)=0 $，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{y(zF_{2}^{\prime}-x^{2}F_{1}^{\prime})}{x(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime})} $。将方程 $ F\left(x+\frac{z}{y},y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0 $ 两边对 $ y $ 求导得 $ F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{z}{y^{2}}+\frac{1}{y}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)=0 $，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{x\left(zF_{1}^{\prime}-y^{2}F_{2}^{\prime}\right)}{y\left(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime}\right)} $。所以 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{z(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime})-(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime})xy}{xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime}}=z-xy $。

stem: 设函数 $ F(u,v) $ 可微，且 $ F\left(x+\frac{z}{y},y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0 $ 确定隐函数 $ z = z(x,y) $，则 $ z - x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___.
explanation:
这是一个经典的多元复合函数隐函数求导问题。解决这类问题的关键是引入中间变量，并熟练、准确地运用**多元链式法则**。

我们可以通过设出中间变量，分别求出偏导数 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$ 和 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $，最后代入目标式子进行化简。

### 解题步骤

**第一步：设定中间变量及记号**
令 $ u = x + \frac{z}{y} $， $ v = y + \frac{z}{x} $。
此时原方程化为 $ F(u, v) = 0 $。
记 $F$ 对第一个变量 $u$ 的偏导数为 $ F_1 $，对第二个变量 $v$ 的偏导数为 $ F_2 $。

**第二步：求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $**
对方程 $F\left(x+\frac{z}{y}, y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0$ 两边同时对 $x$ 求偏导（把 $y$ 视为常数），根据链式法则有：
$$
F_1 \cdot \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + F_2 \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = 0
$$

分别计算 $u$ 和 $v$ 对 $x$ 的偏导数（注意 $z$ 是 $x,y$ 的函数）：
* $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = 1 + \frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$
* $\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = \frac{x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - z}{x^2} = \frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{z}{x^2}$

将其代入上式：
$$
F_1 \left(1 + \frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) + F_2 \left(\frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{z}{x^2}\right) = 0
$$

将含有 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$ 的项移到一边，整理可得：
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \left( \frac{F_1}{y} + \frac{F_2}{x} \right) = \frac{z F_2}{x^2} - F_1
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \left( \frac{x F_1 + y F_2}{xy} \right) = \frac{z F_2 - x^2 F_1}{x^2}
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{y(z F_2 - x^2 F_1)}{x(x F_1 + y F_2)}
$$

**第三步：求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $**
同理，对方程两边同时对 $y$ 求偏导（把 $x$ 视为常数）：
$$
F_1 \cdot \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + F_2 \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = 0
$$

分别计算偏导：
* $\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = \frac{y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - z}{y^2} = \frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - \frac{z}{y^2}$
* $\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = 1 + \frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}$

代入后得到：
$$
F_1 \left(\frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - \frac{z}{y^2}\right) + F_2 \left(1 + \frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right) = 0
$$

整理求解 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $：
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} \left( \frac{F_1}{y} + \frac{F_2}{x} \right) = \frac{z F_1}{y^2} - F_2
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} \left( \frac{x F_1 + y F_2}{xy} \right) = \frac{z F_1 - y^2 F_2}{y^2}
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{x(z F_1 - y^2 F_2)}{y(x F_1 + y F_2)}
$$

**第四步：代入目标表达式化简**
我们需要计算 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $：
* $x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{y(z F_2 - x^2 F_1)}{x F_1 + y F_2} = \frac{yz F_2 - x^2 y F_1}{x F_1 + y F_2}$
* $y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{x(z F_1 - y^2 F_2)}{x F_1 + y F_2} = \frac{xz F_1 - xy^2 F_2}{x F_1 + y F_2}$

将这两部分相加：
$$
x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{-x^2 y F_1 + yz F_2 + xz F_1 - xy^2 F_2}{x F_1 + y F_2}
$$

对分子按照 $F_1$ 和 $F_2$ 提取公因式：
* $F_1$ 的系数：$ xz - x^2 y = x(z - xy) $
* $F_2$ 的系数：$ yz - xy^2 = y(z - xy) $

因此分子可以化简为：
$$
(xz - x^2 y)F_1 + (yz - xy^2)F_2 = (z - xy)(x F_1 + y F_2)
$$

代回原式：
$$
x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{(z - xy)(x F_1 + y F_2)}{x F_1 + y F_2} = z - xy
$$

最后，计算题目所求的完整表达式：
$$
z - x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = z - (z - xy) = xy
$$

---

**最终答案：** $ xy $

explanation: $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}}{\frac{\partial F}{\partial z}}=-\frac{F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\frac{1}{z}}{F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{x}{z^{2}}\right)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet y} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}}{\frac{\partial F}{\partial z}}=-\frac{F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet z}{F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{x}{z^{2}}\right)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet y} $，则 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=z $。

stem: 已知二元函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ f\left(\frac{ye^{x}}{z}, \ln z\right) = 1 $ 确定，其中 f 存在一阶偏导数，则下列结论中，正确的是（）
explanation:
设 $u=\dfrac{ye^x}{z},v=\ln z$。对方程 $f(u,v)=1$ 分别关于 $x,y$ 求偏导，得 
$$
f_1'\left(\frac{ye^x}{z}-\frac{ye^x}{z^2}z_x\right)+f_2'\frac{z_x}{z}=0,
$$
 
$$
f_1'\left(\frac{e^x}{z}-\frac{ye^x}{z^2}z_y\right)+f_2'\frac{z_y}{z}=0.
$$
 两式同乘 $z^2$ 并解出偏导数，得 
$$
z_x=\frac{ye^xz f_1'}{ye^xf_1'-zf_2'},\qquad z_y=\frac{e^xz f_1'}{ye^xf_1'-zf_2'}.
$$
 因而 
$$
z_x=yz_y,
$$
 即 $\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial y}$。故选 B。

options.content_md: $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial z}.$

options.label: B
options.content_md: $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial x}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial y}{\partial z}.$

options.label: C
options.content_md: $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \cdot \frac{\partial x}{\partial y} \cdot \frac{\partial y}{\partial z} = 1.$

options.label: D
options.content_md: $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \cdot \frac{\partial x}{\partial y} \cdot \frac{\partial y}{\partial z} = -1.$

explanation:
由隐函数存在定理可得 
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\cdot\frac{\partial x}{\partial y}\cdot\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}=\left(-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}\right)\cdot\left(-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}}{F_{x}^{\prime}}\right)\cdot\left(-\frac{F_{z}^{\prime}}{F_{y}^{\prime}}\right)=-1.
$$
 于是，选项 C 不正确，选项 D 正确。取 $F(x,y,z)=2x+y-z$ , 则 $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=2,\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}=1,\frac{\partial F}{\partial z}=-1$ . 选项 A 不正确. 由隐函数存在定理， $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=2,\frac{\partial x}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}}{F_{x}^{\prime}}=-\frac{1}{2},\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}=-\frac{F_{z}^{\prime}}{F_{y}^{\prime}}=1.$ 选项 B 不正确. 综上所述，应选 D.

explanation:
解（Ⅰ）解法1 对方程 $ 2xy - z = \varphi(x + 2y + 3z) $ 两端分别关于 $x$, $y$ 求偏导数，得 $ 2y - \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) \left(1 + 3\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) $， $ 2x - \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) \left(2 + 3\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right) $。由于 $ \varphi'(t) \neq -\frac{1}{3} $，故 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{2y - \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{2x - 2\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} $。因此， $ \mathrm{d}z = \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \mathrm{d}x + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} \mathrm{d}y = \frac{2y - \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} \mathrm{d}x + \frac{2x - 2\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} \mathrm{d}y $。
解法 2 对方程 $ 2xy - z = \varphi(x + 2y + 3z) $ 两端微分，可得
$$
 2y\mathrm{d}x+2x\mathrm{d}y-\mathrm{d}z=\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+2y+3z\right)\mathrm{d}x+2\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+2y+3z\right)\mathrm{d}y+3\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+2y+3z\right)\mathrm{d}z. 
$$
 
由于 $\varphi^{\prime}(t)\neq-\frac{1}{3}$，故 $\mathrm{d}z=\frac{2y-\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}\mathrm{d}x+\frac{2x-2\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}\mathrm{d}y$。
(Ⅱ) 由第(Ⅰ)问中所求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $的表达式可知，
$$
 u(x,y)=\frac{1}{x-2y}\cdot\frac{4y-2x}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}=\frac{-2}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}. 
$$
 
于是，
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}&=\frac{2\cdot\frac{\partial\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)\right]}{\partial x}}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}=\frac{6\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)\cdot\left(1+3\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}\\&=\frac{6(6y+1)\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{3}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}&=\frac{2\cdot\frac{\partial\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)\right]}{\partial y}}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}=\frac{6\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)\cdot\left(2+3\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}\\&=\frac{6(6x+2)\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{3}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 
因此， $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{6(6y-6x-1)\varphi''(x+2y+3z)}{\left[3\varphi'(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^3}. $

stem: 设有三元方程 $ x\arctan x + \frac{\ln x}{\ln y} + ze^{\sin z} = \frac{\pi}{4} $，根据隐函数存在定理，存在点 $ (1, e, 0) $ 的一个邻域，在此邻域内该方程（）

options.label: A
options.content_md: 只能确定一个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ z = z(x, y) $.

options.label: B
options.content_md: 可确定两个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ y = y(x, z) $ 和 $ z = z(x, y) $.

options.label: C
options.content_md: 可确定两个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ x = x(y, z) $ 和 $ z = z(x, y) $.

options.label: D
options.content_md: 可确定两个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ x = x(y, z) $ 和 $ y = y(x, z) $.

explanation:
正确答案为 C。

第一步，构造隐函数方程并检查适用条件。令
$$
F(x,y,z)=x\arctan x+\frac{\ln x}{\ln y}
+ze^{\sin z}-\frac{\pi}{4}.
$$
记 $P=(1,e,0)$，则 $F(P)=0$。在 $P$ 的充分小邻域内，$x>0$、$y>0$ 且 $y\ne1$，故 $F$ 及其一阶偏导数均连续。

第二步，分别计算三个偏导数：
$$
F_x=\arctan x+\frac{x}{1+x^2}+\frac1{x\ln y},
$$
$$
F_y=-\frac{\ln x}{y(\ln y)^2},
$$
$$
F_z=e^{\sin z}(1+z\cos z).
$$
代入点 $P$，得到
$$
F_x(P)=\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac32\ne0,
$$
$$
F_y(P)=0,\qquad F_z(P)=1\ne0.
$$

第三步，判断可以确定哪些隐函数。

因为 $F_x(P)\ne0$，由隐函数存在定理，在相应邻域内可以唯一确定具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $x=x(y,z)$。

因为 $F_z(P)\ne0$，同理可以唯一确定具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $z=z(x,y)$。

最后，说明为什么不能选择含 $y=y(x,z)$ 的选项。仅由 $F_y(P)=0$，只能说明不能直接用定理对 $y$ 求解，不能一般性地断言隐函数不存在。本题还可作如下验证：

假设存在经过 $P$ 且具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $y=y(x,z)$，则恒有
$$
F(x,y(x,z),z)=0.
$$
固定 $z$，两边对 $x$ 求偏导，由链式法则得到
$$
F_x+F_y\,y_x=0.
$$
在 $P$ 处代入已算出的偏导数，就要求
$$
\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac32+0\cdot y_x(1,0)=0,
$$
矛盾。因此本题不能确定这样的 $y=y(x,z)$。

综上，可确定的两个具有连续偏导数的隐函数为 $x=x(y,z)$ 和 $z=z(x,y)$，选 C。

stem: 已知 $ u + e^{u} = xy $，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} $。
explanation:
由 $u+e^u=xy$，两边分别对 $x,y$ 求偏导，得 
$$
u_x(1+e^u)=y,\qquad u_y(1+e^u)=x,
$$
 即 
$$
u_x=\frac{y}{1+e^u},\qquad u_y=\frac{x}{1+e^u}.
$$
 再对 $u_x=\dfrac{y}{1+e^u}$ 关于 $y$ 求导，得 
$$
u_{xy}=\frac{1}{1+e^u}-\frac{y e^u u_y}{(1+e^u)^2}=\frac{1}{1+e^u}-\frac{xy e^u}{(1+e^u)^3}.
$$
 由 $xy=u+e^u$，可化为 
$$
u_{xy}=\frac{(1+e^u)^2-(u+e^u)e^u}{(1+e^u)^3}=\frac{1+(2-u)e^u}{(1+e^u)^3}.
$$

stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由 $ e^{z} + xz = 2x - y $ 确定，则 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} \right|_{(1,1)} = $ ___。
explanation: 将 $ x=1, y=1 $ 代入方程 $ e^{z} + xz = 2x - y $，得 $ e^{z}+z=1 \Rightarrow z=0 $。方程两边对 x 求偏导： $ e^{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+z+x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=2 \Rightarrow \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,1)}=1 $。再对 x 求偏导： $ e^{z}(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x})^{2}+e^{z}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+x\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=0 \Rightarrow \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\bigg|_{(1,1)}=-\frac{3}{2} $。

stem:
设函数 $z=z(x,y)$ 由方程
$$
z+e^x-y\ln(1+z^2)=0
$$
确定，求
$$
\left.(z_{xx}+z_{yy})\right|_{(0,0)}.
$$
explanation:
第一步：求原点处的函数值与 $z_{xx}$。

令 $x=y=0$，得
$$
z(0,0)=-1.
$$

沿 $y=0$，原方程直接化为
$$
z(x,0)=-e^x.
$$

对 $x$ 求两次导数，得到
$$
z_{xx}(0,0)=-1.
$$

第二步：求 $z_y(0,0)$。

为简化书写，记
$$
g(z)=\ln(1+z^2).
$$

原方程可写为
$$
z+e^x=yg(z).
$$

保持 $x$ 不变，对 $y$ 求导：
$$
z_y=g(z)+yg'(z)z_y.
$$

代入 $(x,y)=(0,0)$，有
$$
z_y(0,0)=g(-1)=\ln2.
$$

第三步：再求一次偏导，保留乘积求导产生的两项。

对上式继续关于 $y$ 求导：
$$
\begin{aligned}
z_{yy}
&=g'(z)z_y+g'(z)z_y\\
&\phantom{={}}+y\bigl[g''(z)z_y^2+g'(z)z_{yy}\bigr].
\end{aligned}
$$

其中，前一个 $g'(z)z_y$ 来自 $g(z)$ 的导数，后一个来自 $yg'(z)z_y$ 中 $y$ 的导数；二者都不能漏掉。

由于
$$
g'(-1)=\left.\frac{2z}{1+z^2}\right|_{z=-1}=-1,
$$
在原点代入 $y=0$，得
$$
\begin{aligned}
z_{yy}(0,0)
&=2g'(-1)z_y(0,0)\\
&=-2\ln2.
\end{aligned}
$$

第四步：相加得到结果。

$$
\boxed{\left.(z_{xx}+z_{yy})\right|_{(0,0)}
=-1-2\ln2}.
$$

stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 是由 $ z + e^{z} = xy $ 所确定的二元函数，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{z=0} = $ ___。
explanation: 将 $ z + e^{z} = xy $ 写成 $ F(x, y, z) = xy - z - e^{z} = 0 $，按隐函数求导公式，有 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}(x,y,z)}{F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z)}=-\frac{y}{-1-\mathrm{e}^{z}}=\frac{y}{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}(x,y,z)}{F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z)}=-\frac{x}{-1-\mathrm{e}^{z}}=\frac{x}{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}} $。故 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\Big(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\Big)=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\Big(\frac{y}{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}}\Big)=\frac{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}-y\mathrm{e}^{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}}{(1+\mathrm{e}^{z})^{2}}=\frac{1}{1+\mathrm{e}^{z}}-\frac{xy\mathrm{e}^{z}}{(1+\mathrm{e}^{z})^{3}} $。以 $ z = 0 $ 代入 $ F(x, y, z) = 0 $ 中，得 $ xy = 1 $，从而得 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{z=0} = \frac{3}{8} $。

stem: 已知函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ e^{z} + xz - y\ln x = 1 $ 所确定，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)} = $_ .
explanation:
将 $ x = 1, y = 1 $ 代入原方程得 $ e^{z} + z = 1 $. 令 $ g(z) = e^{z} + z - 1 $, 则 $ g'(z) = e^{z} + 1 > 0 $, $ g(z) $ 单调增加. 观察可得 $ g(0) = 0 $, 结合 $ g(z) $ 的单调性可知 $ z = 0 $ 为 $ g(z) $ 的唯一零点, 即 $ z(1,1) = 0 $. 对已知方程两端分别关于 $ x $ 和 $ y $ 求偏导得： 
$$
 \begin{aligned} e^{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+z-\frac{y}{x}&=0,\\ e^{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+x\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-\ln x&=0. \end{aligned} 
$$
 代入 $ x = 1, y = 1, z = 0 $ 得， 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+0-1=0,\quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-0=0. 
$$
 解得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,1)}=\frac{1}{2},\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}=0. $ 继续对第一个偏导式两端关于 $ y $ 求偏导数可得， 
$$
 e^{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+e^{z}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}+x\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-\frac{1}{x}=0. 
$$
 代入 $ x = 1, y = 1, z = 0, \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,1)} = \frac{1}{2}, \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)} = 0 $ 得, $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} - 1 = 0 $. 解得 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)} = \frac{1}{2} $.

stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 是由方程 $ 3x + xyz + z^{3} = 1 $ 所确定的函数，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{x=0,y=0} = $ ______.
explanation:
令 $ F(x,y,z)=3x+xyz+z^{3}-1 $，则 $ F_{x}^{\prime}=3+yz $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}=xy+3z^{2} $. 当 $ x=0 $，$ y=0 $ 时，由方程得 $ z=1 $，于是， 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{3+yz}{xy+3z^{2}},\quad.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}|_{\substack{x=0\\ y=0}}=-\frac{3+yz}{xy+3z^{2}}|_{\substack{x=0\\ y=0\\ z=1}}=-1, 
$$
 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{\substack{x=0\\ y=0}}=-\left.\frac{y\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}(x y+3z^{2})-(3+y z)\left(y+6z\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)}{(x y+3z^{2})^{2}}\right|_{\substack{x=0\\ y=0\\ z=1}}=-2. 
$$

stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} - 2x - 4y - 2z = 0 $（$z \gt 0$）确定，则当 $ x = 2, y = 4 $ 时，下列选项正确的是？
explanation:
当 $ x = 2, y = 4 $ 时，原方程化为 $ z^{2} - 2z = 0 $. 由已知条件 $ z > 0 $，得 $ z = 2 $. 原方程两端分别关于 $ x $ 和 $ y $ 求偏导数得： 
$$
 2x+2z z_{x}^{\prime}-2-2z_{x}^{\prime}=0,\quad2y+2z z_{y}^{\prime}-4-2z_{y}^{\prime}=0. 
$$
 代入 $ x = 2, y = 4, z = 2 $ 可得 $ z_{x}^{\prime} = -1, z_{y}^{\prime} = -2 $. 对上述两式两端分别关于 $ x, y $ 求偏导数得： 
$$
 2+2(z_{x}^{\prime})^{2}+2zz_{xx}^{\prime\prime}-2z_{xx}^{\prime\prime}=0,\quad2+2(z_{y}^{\prime})^{2}+2zz_{yy}^{\prime\prime}-2z_{yy}^{\prime\prime}=0. 
$$
 代入 $ x = 2, y = 4, z = 2, z_{x}^{\prime} = -1, z_{y}^{\prime} = -2 $ 可得 $ z_{xx}^{\prime\prime} = -2, z_{yy}^{\prime\prime} = -5 $. 应选 C.

stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 是由方程 $ 3xy + 2x - 4y - z = e^{z} $ 确定的隐函数，且 $ z(1, 1) = 0 $，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)} = $
explanation:
设 
$$
F(x,y,z)=3xy+2x-4y-z-e^z=0.
$$
 有 
$$
F_x=3y+2,\quad F_y=3x-4,\quad F_z=-1-e^z.
$$
 在 $(1,1,0)$ 处，$F_x=5,F_y=-1,F_z=-2$，故 
$$
z_x=-\frac{F_x}{F_z}=\frac52,\qquad z_y=-\frac{F_y}{F_z}=-\frac12.
$$
 对 $F_x+F_z z_x=0$ 关于 $y$ 求导，得 
$$
F_{xy}+F_{xz}z_y+(F_{zy}+F_{zz}z_y)z_x+F_z z_{xy}=0.
$$
 由于 $F_{xy}=3,F_{xz}=F_{zy}=0,F_{zz}=-e^z=-1$，代入得 
$$
3-z_xz_y-2z_{xy}=0.
$$
 因此 
$$
z_{xy}=\frac{3-z_xz_y}{2}=\frac{3-\left(\frac52\right)\left(-\frac12\right)}{2}=\frac{17}{8}=2\frac18,
$$
 选 B。

stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 是由方程 $ z + \ln z - \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^{2}} dt = 1 $ 确定的函数，计算 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{(0,0)} $.
explanation:
在 $ z + \ln z - \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^{2}} dt = 1 $ 两边对 x 求导，有 
$$
 \left(1+\frac{1}{z}\right)\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}}=0,\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{z}{1+z}\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}}. 
$$
 类似可得 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{z}{1+z}\mathrm{e}^{-y^{2}}, 
$$
 故 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}&=\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}}\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\Big(\frac{z}{1+z}\Big)=\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}}\frac{\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}}{(1+z)^{2}}\\&=-\frac{z}{(1+z)^{3}}\mathrm{e}^{-(x^{2}+y^{2})}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 将 x=0, y=0 代入原方程，得 $ z + \ln z - 1 = 0 $。令 $ f(z) = z + \ln z - 1 $，则 $ \lim_{z\to0^{+}}f(z)=-\infty,\lim_{z\to+\infty}f(z)=+\infty, $ $ f^{\prime}(z)=1+\frac{1}{z}>0, $ 所以 $ f(z) $ 有唯一零点。易见 $ f(1)=0 $, 所以 x=0, y=0 时, z=1, 代入上式, 得 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(0,0)}=-\frac{1}{8}. 
$$

stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ z + \ln z - \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^{2}} \, dt = 0 $ 确定，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} = $ ___。
explanation:
已知方程两边同时对 x, y 求偏导数，得 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}}=0,\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+\frac{1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+\mathrm{e}^{-y^{2}}=0. 
$$
 由以上两式解得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{z\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}}}{1+z},\quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{-z\mathrm{e}^{-y^{2}}}{1+z} $，故 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\cdot(1+z)-z\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}}{(1+z)^{2}}\\&=\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-x^{2}}}{(1+z)^{2}}\cdot\left(\frac{-z\mathrm{e}^{-y^{2}}}{1+z}\right)=\frac{-z\mathrm{e}^{-(x^{2}+y^{2})}}{(1+z)^{3}}.\end{aligned} 
$$

stem: 已知方程 $ 2z - e^{z} + 1 + \int_{y}^{x^{2}} \sin(t^{2}) dt = 0 $ 在 $ (x_{0}, y_{0}, z_{0}) = (1, 1, 0) $ 的某个邻域中确定了一个隐函数 $ z = z(x, y) $，求 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y}\right|_{(1,1)} $.
explanation:
设 $ F(x,y,z)=2z-\mathrm{e}^{z}+1+\int_{y}^{x^{2}}\sin(t^{2})\mathrm{d}t $，则 
$$
 F_{x}^{\prime}=2x\sin(x^{4}),F_{y}^{\prime}=-\sin(y^{2}),F_{z}^{\prime}=2-\mathrm{e}^{z}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{2x\sin(x^{4})}{2-\mathrm{e}^{z}},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=\frac{\sin(y^{2})}{2-\mathrm{e}^{z}}. 
$$
 将 x=1, y=1, z=0 代入，得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,1)} = -2\sin 1, \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)} = \sin 1 $，则 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}=\left.\frac{-2x\sin(x^{4})\mathrm{e}^{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}}{(2-\mathrm{e}^{z})^{2}}\right|_{(1,1,0)}=-2\sin^{2}1. 
$$

stem: 设 $ f(u,v) $ 存在二阶连续偏导数, $ z = z(x,y) $ 是由方程 $ f(z - x, z - y) = 1 $ 确定的隐函数, 求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} $.
explanation:
对方程 $ f(z-x,z-y)=1 $ 两边关于 y 求偏导，得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}f_{1}^{\prime}+\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-1\right)f_{2}^{\prime}=0 $，知 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{f_{2}^{\prime}}{f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}} $。同理， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{f_{1}^{\prime}}{f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}} $，故
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\frac{\partial f_{1}^{\prime}}{\partial y}(f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime})-\frac{\partial(f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime})}{\partial y}f_{1}^{\prime}}{(f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime})^{2}}\\&=\frac{\left[f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+f_{12}^{\prime\prime}\bullet\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-1\right)\right]f_{2}^{\prime}-\left[f_{21}^{\prime\prime}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+f_{22}^{\prime\prime}\bullet\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-1\right)\right]f_{1}^{\prime}}{(f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime})^{2}}\\&=\frac{f_{11}^{\prime\prime}(f_{2}^{\prime})^{2}-2f_{1}^{\prime}f_{2}^{\prime}f_{12}^{\prime\prime}+f_{22}^{\prime\prime}(f_{1}^{\prime})^{2}}{(f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime})^{3}}.\end{align*} 
$$

explanation:
由题设知 $ y = y(x) $ 与 $ z = z(x) $ 是由方程组
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}z&=x^{2}+2y^{2}\\ x^{2}-xy+y^{2}&=1\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
确定的两个隐函数，将方程组中每个方程看成关于 x 的恒等式并对 x 求导数，得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}z^{\prime}&=2x+4y y^{\prime}\\ 2x-y-x y^{\prime}+2y y^{\prime}&=0\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
用 x = 1, $ y(1) = 1 $ 代入可得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}z^{\prime}(1)&=2+4y^{\prime}(1)\\ 2-1-y^{\prime}(1)+2y^{\prime}(1)&=0\end{aligned}\right.\Rightarrow\left\{\begin{aligned}y^{\prime}(1)&=-1\\ z^{\prime}(1)&=-2\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
将方程组中每个方程看成关于x的恒等式，对x求导数，得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}z^{\prime \prime}&=2+4(y^{\prime})^{2}+4y y^{\prime \prime}\\ 2-y^{\prime}-y^{\prime}-x y^{\prime \prime}+2(y^{\prime})^{2}+2y y^{\prime \prime}=0\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
用 x = 1, $ y(1) = 1 $ 和 $ y'(1) = -1 $ 代入上面所得的方程组即得
$$
 \left\{\begin{aligned}z^{\prime \prime}(1)&=2+4+4y^{\prime \prime}(1)\\ 2+2-y^{\prime \prime}(1)&+2+2y^{\prime \prime}(1)\end{aligned}\right.\Rightarrow\left\{\begin{aligned}y^{\prime \prime}(1)&=-6\\ z^{\prime \prime}(1)&=-18\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
故应选(D).

stem: 已知函数 $ f(u) $ 具有二阶导数，且 $ f'(1) = 1 $，函数 $ y = y(x) $ 由方程 $ \ln y - xe^{y} = 1 - \cos x $ 所确定。设 $ z = f(y - \arctan ex) $，求 $ \left. \frac{dz}{dx} \right|_{x=0}, \left. \frac{d^{2}z}{dx^{2}} \right|_{x=0} $。
explanation:
由链式法则,我们有
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=f^{\prime}(y-\arctan\mathrm{e}x)\left(y^{\prime}-\frac{\mathrm{e}}{1+\mathrm{e}^{2}x^{2}}\right), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}z}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}=\frac{\mathrm{d}\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)}{\mathrm{d}x}=f^{\prime \prime}(y-\arctan\mathrm{e}x)\left(y^{\prime}-\frac{\mathrm{e}}{1+\mathrm{e}^{2}x^{2}}\right)^{2}+f^{\prime}(y-\arctan\mathrm{e}x)\left[y^{\prime \prime}+\frac{2\mathrm{e}^{3}x}{\left(1+\mathrm{e}^{2}x^{2}\right)^{2}}\right]. 
$$
 
由上可知，要求得 $ \left.\frac{dz}{dx}\right|_{x=0} $以及 $ \left.\frac{d^{2}z}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=0} $，需要知道 $ y,y',y'' $在x=0处的值.
由 $ \ln y - xe^{y} = 1 - \cos x $ 知， $ y(0) = 1 $.
下面计算 $ y'(0) $, $ y''(0) $.
对等式 $ \ln y - xe^{y} = 1 - \cos x $ 两端关于 x 求导，得
$$
 \frac{y^{\prime}}{y}-\mathrm{e}^{y}-x\mathrm{e}^{y}y^{\prime}=\sin x. 
$$
 
代入 $ y(0) = 1 $，得 $ y'(0) = e $.
对(1)式两端再次关于x求导,得
$$
 \frac{y^{\prime \prime}y-\left(y^{\prime}\right)^{2}}{y^{2}}-\mathrm{e}^{y}y^{\prime}-\mathrm{e}^{y}y^{\prime}-x\mathrm{e}^{y}\left(y^{\prime}\right)^{2}-x\mathrm{e}^{y}y^{\prime \prime}=\cos x. 
$$
 
代入 $ y(0)=1, y'(0)=\mathrm{e} $，得 $ y''(0)=1+3\mathrm{e}^{2} $
将 $ y(0) = 1, y'(0) = e, y''(0) = 1 + 3e^{2} $ 以及 $ f'(1) = 1 $ 代回 $ \frac{dz}{dx} $ 和 $ \frac{d^{2}z}{dx^{2}} $ 的表达式，得
$$
 \left.\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}\right|_{x=0}=f^{\prime}(1)(e-e)=0, 
$$
 
$$
 \left.\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}z}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}\right|_{x=0}=f^{\prime \prime}(1)\left(\mathrm{e}-\mathrm{e}\right)^{2}+f^{\prime}(1)\left(1+3\mathrm{e}^{2}+0\right)=1+3\mathrm{e}^{2}. 
$$
source: 900 第四章数二 B 类 24

stem: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数， $ y = y(x) $ 由方程 $ \tan y - y = x $ 所确定，令 $ z(x) = f(x, x - y) $，计算 $ \left. \frac{d^2 z}{dx^2} \right|_{x=1-\frac{\pi}{4}} $。
explanation:
计算 $ \frac{dz}{dx},\frac{d^{2}z}{dx^{2}} $。
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right), 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}z}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}&=f_{11}^{\prime \prime}+f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)+f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)+f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)^{2}-f_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}\\&=f_{11}^{\prime \prime}+2f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)+f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)^{2}-f_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
令 $ F(y) = \tan y - y $，计算可得
$$
 F^{\prime}(y)=\sec^{2}y-1=\tan^{2}y\geqslant0. 
$$
于是， $ F(y) $ 单调增加。由于 $ F\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=1-\frac{\pi}{4} $，故当 $ x=1-\frac{\pi}{4} $ 时， $ y=\frac{\pi}{4} $。
下面计算 $ \frac{dy}{dx},\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} $。对方程 $ \tan y - y = x $ 两端同时关于 x 求导，得 $ \sec^{2}y \cdot \frac{dy}{dx} - \frac{dy}{dx} = 1 $，即 $ \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{\sec^{2}y - 1} = \frac{1}{\tan^{2}y} $。
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}x^{2}}=\frac{-2\tan y\sec^{2}y}{\tan^{4}y}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{-2\sec^{2}y}{\tan^{3}y}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}. 
$$
代入 $ x = 1 - \frac{\pi}{4}, y = \frac{\pi}{4} $ 知， $ \left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{x=1-\frac{\pi}{4}} = 1, \left.\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right|_{x=1-\frac{\pi}{4}} = -4 $。
因此， $ \left.\frac{d^{2}z}{dx^{2}}\right|_{x=1-\frac{\pi}{4}}=f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\left(1-\frac{\pi}{4},1-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)+4f_{2}^{\prime}\left(1-\frac{\pi}{4},1-\frac{\pi}{2}\right) $。
source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 35

stem: 设 $ u = f(x, y, z) $， $ \varphi(x^{2}, \mathrm{e}^{y}, z) = 0 $， $ y = \sin x $，其中 $ f, \varphi $ 都具有一阶连续偏导数，且 $ \frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial z} \neq 0 $，求 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x} $。
explanation:
复合函数求导。
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}. 
$$
由 $ y=\sin x $，得 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\cos x $。
由隐函数 $ \varphi\left(x^{2},\mathrm{~e}^{y},z\right)=0 $ 且 $ \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial z}\neq0 $，得
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=-\frac{\varphi_{x}^{\prime}}{\varphi_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{\varphi_{1}^{\prime}\cdot2x+\varphi_{2}^{\prime}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{y}\cdot\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}}{\varphi_{3}^{\prime}}=-\frac{1}{\varphi_{3}^{\prime}}\left(2x\varphi_{1}^{\prime}+\mathrm{e}^{y}\cos x\cdot\varphi_{2}^{\prime}\right). 
$$
将 $ \frac{dy}{dx} $， $ \frac{dz}{dx} $ 以及 $ y = \sin x $ 代入 $ \frac{du}{dx} $，得
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\cos x-\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}\cdot\frac{1}{\varphi_{3}^{\prime}}\left(2x\varphi_{1}^{\prime}+\mathrm{e}^{\sin x}\cos x\cdot\varphi_{2}^{\prime}\right). 
$$

stem: 设 $u=f(x,y,z)$ 有连续偏导数，$y=y(x)$ 和 $z=z(x)$ 分别由方程 $e^{xy}-y=0$ 和 $e^{x}-xz=0$ 所确定，求 $\frac{du}{dx}$。
explanation:
由全导数公式，
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_x+f_y\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+f_z\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}.
$$
对 $\mathrm{e}^{xy}-y=0$ 求导，得
$$
\mathrm{e}^{xy}(y+xy')-y'=0.
$$
利用 $\mathrm{e}^{xy}=y$，可得
$$
y'=\frac{y^2}{1-xy}.
$$
对题干中的第二个方程 $\mathrm{e}^x-xz=0$ 求导，得
$$
\mathrm{e}^x-z-xz'=0.
$$
再利用 $\mathrm{e}^x=xz$，得到
$$
z'=\frac{\mathrm{e}^x-z}{x}=\frac{z(x-1)}{x}.
$$
代入全导数公式，即得
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_x+\frac{y^2}{1-xy}f_y+\frac{z(x-1)}{x}f_z.
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元隐函数求偏导 / 两个方程三个未知数

stem: 设 $ u=f(x,y,z) $ 有连续偏导数， $ y=y(x),z=z(x) $ 分别由方程 $ e^{xy}-y=0 $ 和 $ e^{z}-xz=0 $ 确定，求 $ \frac{du}{dx} $。
explanation:
依题设，有
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+f_{3}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}. 
$$
方程 $ e^{xy}-y=0 $ 两边同时对 x 求导，得 $ e^{xy}\left(y+x\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right)-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=0 $，解得
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{y^{2}}{1-xy}. 
$$
方程 $ e^{z}-xz=0 $ 两边同时对 x 求导，得 $ e^{z}\frac{dz}{dx}-z-x\frac{dz}{dx}=0 $，解得
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{z}{xz-x}. 
$$
将以上两式代入，得 $ \frac{du}{dx}=f_{1}^{\prime}+\frac{y^{2}}{1-xy}f_{2}^{\prime}+\frac{z}{xz-x}f_{3}^{\prime} $。
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元隐函数求偏导 / 两个方程三个未知数

stem: 设 $ \begin{cases}y=f(x,t),\\F(x,y,t)=0,\end{cases} $ $ f,F $ 有一阶连续偏导数，则 $ \frac{dy}{dx}= $___
explanation:
由已知方程组确定 $ y = y(x) $， $ t = t(x) $，方程两边同时对 $ x $ 求导，得 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_{x}^{\prime}+f_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x},\ F_{x}^{\prime}+F_{y}^{\prime}\bullet\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+F_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x}=0, 
$$
 两式消去 $ \frac{dt}{dx} $，得 $ \frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{f_{x}^{\prime}F_{t}^{\prime}-f_{t}^{\prime}F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{t}^{\prime}+f_{t}^{\prime}F_{y}^{\prime}} $。

stem: 设 $ y = y(x) $, $ z = z(x) $ 是由方程 $ z = xf(x + y) $ 和 $ F(x, y, z) = 0 $ 所确定的函数，其中 $ f $ 和 $ F $ 分别具有一阶连续导数和一阶连续偏导数，求 $ \frac{dz}{dx} $。
explanation:
对 $ x $ 求导： 
$$
 \frac{d z}{d x}=f(x+y)+x f^{\prime}(x+y)\left(1+\frac{d y}{d x}\right), 
$$
 
$$
 F_{x}^{\prime}+F_{y}^{\prime}\cdot\frac{d y}{d x}+F_{z}^{\prime}\cdot\frac{d z}{d x}=0. 
$$
 联立解得： 
$$
 \frac{d z}{d x}=\frac{(f+x f^{\prime})F_{y}^{\prime}-x f^{\prime}F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{y}^{\prime}+x f^{\prime}F_{z}^{\prime}}。 
$$

stem: 设 $ y = y(x) $, $ z = z(x) $ 由方程组 $ \begin{cases} x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = 3x, \\ 2x - 3y + 5z = 4 \end{cases} $ 确定，求 $ \frac{dy}{dx} $， $ \frac{dz}{dx} $。
explanation:
方程组两边同时对 $ x $ 求导，得 
$$
 \begin{cases}2x+2y\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+2z\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=3,\\2-3\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+5\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=0,\end{cases} 
$$
 解方程组，得 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\left|\begin{array}{cc}3-2x&2z\\ -2&5\end{array}\right|}{\left|\begin{array}{cc}2y&2z\\ -3&5\end{array}\right|}=-\frac{10x-4z-15}{2(5y+3z)}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\left|\begin{array}{cc}2y&3-2x\\-3&-2\end{array}\right|}{\left|\begin{array}{cc}2y&2z\\-3&5\end{array}\right|}=-\frac{6x+4y-9}{2(5y+3z)}。 
$$

stem: 设 $ x = x(y) $, $ z = z(y) $ 由方程组 $ \begin{cases} F(y - x, y - z) = 0, \\ G\left(xy, \frac{z}{y}\right) = 0 \end{cases} $ 确定，求 $ \frac{dx}{dy}, \frac{dz}{dy} $。
explanation:
方程组等号两边同时对 $ y $ 求导，得 
$$
 \begin{cases}F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}y}\right)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}y}\right)=0,\\G_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\left(x+y\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}y}\right)+G_{2}^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{z}{y^{2}}+\frac{1}{y}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}y}\right)=0,\end{cases} 
$$
 整理，得 
$$
 \begin{cases}F_{1}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}y}+F_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}y}=F_{1}^{\prime}+F_{2}^{\prime},\\yG_{1}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}y}+\frac{1}{y}G_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}y}=\frac{z}{y^{2}}G_{2}^{\prime}-xG_{1}^{\prime},\end{cases} 
$$
 解此方程组，得 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}y}=\frac{\left|\begin{array}{cc}F_{1}^{\prime}+F_{2}^{\prime}&F_{2}^{\prime}\\\frac{z}{y^{2}}G_{2}^{\prime}-xG_{1}^{\prime}&\frac{1}{y}G_{2}^{\prime}\\\end{array}\right|}{\left|\begin{array}{cc}F_{1}^{\prime}&F_{2}^{\prime}\\yG_{1}^{\prime}&\frac{1}{y}G_{2}^{\prime}\\\end{array}\right|}=\frac{\frac{1}{y}F_{1}^{\prime}G_{2}^{\prime}+xF_{2}^{\prime}G_{1}^{\prime}+\left(\frac{1}{y}-\frac{z}{y^{2}}\right)F_{2}^{\prime}G_{2}^{\prime}}{\frac{1}{y}F_{1}^{\prime}G_{2}^{\prime}-yF_{2}^{\prime}G_{1}^{\prime}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}y}=-\frac{(x+y)F_{1}^{\prime}G_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime}G_{1}^{\prime}-\frac{z}{y^{2}}F_{1}^{\prime}G_{2}^{\prime}}{\frac{1}{y}F_{1}^{\prime}G_{2}^{\prime}-yF_{2}^{\prime}G_{1}^{\prime}}。 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元隐函数求偏导 / 两个方程三个未知数

stem:
设 $z=z(x,y)$、$t=t(x,y)$ 由方程组
$$
\begin{cases}
x=(t+1)\cos z,\\
y=t\sin z
\end{cases}
$$
确定。在满足隐函数存在定理条件的点处，求 $\displaystyle\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$。
answer:
在 $t+\sin^2z\ne0$ 处，
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{\sin z}{t+\sin^2z}.
$$
若 $\sin z\ne0$，也可写为
$$
-\frac{\sin^2z}{y+\sin^3z}.
$$
若 $\sin z=0$，则在上述正则点处该偏导数为 $0$。
explanation:
将 $y$ 固定，记 $t_x=\partial t/\partial x$、$z_x=\partial z/\partial x$。原方程组对 $x$ 求偏导，得
$$
\begin{cases}
\cos z\,t_x-(t+1)\sin z\,z_x=1,\\
\sin z\,t_x+t\cos z\,z_x=0.
\end{cases}
$$
第一式乘以 $\sin z$，减去第二式乘以 $\cos z$，消去 $t_x$：
$$
-\bigl[(t+1)\sin^2z+t\cos^2z\bigr]z_x=\sin z.
$$
括号内等于 $t+\sin^2z$，所以
$$
\boxed{z_x=-\frac{\sin z}{t+\sin^2z}}.
$$
隐函数存在定理在这里要求 $t+\sin^2z\ne0$，它正是相应雅可比行列式不为零的条件。

当 $\sin z\ne0$ 时，利用 $y=t\sin z$，分子、分母同乘 $\sin z$，可得
$$
z_x=-\frac{\sin^2z}{y+\sin^3z}.
$$
注意分母是 $y+\sin^3z$，不是 $(y+\sin z)^3$。

原答案中的正切形式，在 $\sin z\cos z\ne0$ 时与此等价。因为 $x=(t+1)\cos z$，
$$
y\cos^3z+x\sin^3z
=\sin z\cos z\,(t+\sin^2z),
$$
故
$$
-\frac{\tan^2z}{y+x\tan^3z}
=-\frac{\sin z}{t+\sin^2z}.
$$
为避免正切无定义或约分造成的 $0/0$，答案采用前面的通用形式；特别地，$\sin z=0$ 且 $t\ne0$ 时，直接得到 $z_x=0$。
source: 1994 年江苏省高等数学竞赛题
